name: Media Time Markers Lookup
author: Navidrome
description: Looks up skip/sample markers for a track by AcoustID fingerprint against a crowdsourced GitHub-hosted marker repository (media-time-markers)

acoustidApiKey.title: AcoustID application API key
acoustidApiKey.description: Free key from https://acoustid.org/api-key. Must be an *application* key, not a personal/account key.

library.reason: To read the track's file path for fingerprinting

fingerprint.reason: To compute the track's Chromaprint fingerprint for AcoustID lookup

http.reason: To query AcoustID and fetch marker data from the jsDelivr-mirrored marker repository
